explanation: I found no Mathlib lemma stating that if two functions differ pointwise by at most C on a set, then their conditional infima over that set also differ by at most C. The library proves it from first principles with `le_csInf`, `csInf_le` and `abs_le`. Searches run: (1) names like `abs_csInf_sub`, `abs_ciInf_sub`, `ciInf_sub_ciInf`, `csInf_sub_csInf`, `dist_ciInf` and `dist_ciSup`; (2) `|… sInf/sSup/⨅/⨆ … - …| ≤` and `dist (⨅ …)`/`dist (sInf …)` patterns; (3) `theorem` names that combine `ciInf`, `csInf`, `ciSup` or `csSup` with `sub`, `add`, `dist` or `abs`. None of these turned up a matching statement. The only hit was an unrelated computation in `ENNReal/Lemmas`.
